findings.title: Identical harness collection payload stored twice
findings.body: The T run_harness-run_collection.json.json and C final/harness-run_collection.json.json envelopes decode identical 3,318,465-byte raw payload SHA256 54f97de6c7415742983aae8996e6beba691a50befd12177a2e35a5775f2661ac, but point to separate directory payloads. The unchanged compact_evidence.audit duplicate-bulk rule rejects this. Repackage the C envelope to share the identical same-directory content-addressed payload while preserving the T capture and every source/raw execution binding, then produce a new reviewed revision and rerun storage validation/review.
